Common Questions

Is this calculator official?
No. This calculator provides estimates only based on publicly available information. Official points calculations and eligibility are determined by the Department of Home Affairs when you lodge your application.
How accurate is the points calculation?
This calculator uses publicly available information about the points system. However, policies change frequently, and individual circumstances vary. Always verify with official sources.
What EOI score do I need?
The minimum is 65 points to submit an EOI for most skilled visas. However, actual invitation scores vary significantly by occupation, demand, and visa type. Check SkillSelect data for current invitation rounds.
Can I claim points for multiple categories?
Some categories allow combining points, while others are mutually exclusive. The calculator handles basic calculations, but specific eligibility depends on your individual circumstances.
What English test scores do I need?
IELTS, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT, and Cambridge English are commonly accepted. Each maps to Competent (0 pts), Proficient (10 pts), or Superior (20 pts) levels. Note: PTE scoring thresholds changed in August 2025.
